question: Prerana Shrimali received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in which of the following years for her contribution to the Kathak dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2009**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prerana Shrimali is a renowned Kathak dancer recognized for her contributions to the classical dance form.
 
• She received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2009 for her exceptional work in Kathak.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is one of the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists.
 
• Prerana Shrimali has been instrumental in propagating and preserving the Kathak dance form through her performances and teachings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**

 
 
• Established in 1952, it is the national academy for music, dance, and drama in India.
 
• The Akademi honors artists with awards and fellowships for their outstanding contributions to their respective fields.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the preservation, promotion, and development of the performing arts in India.
 
• The Akademi also organizes various festivals, seminars, and exhibitions to showcase traditional and contemporary arts.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• One of the eight major classical dance forms of India.
 
• Originated from the wandering bards of ancient northern India known as Kathakars or storytellers.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures and facial expressions.
 
• Kathak has evolved over the centuries and incorporates elements from both Hindu and Muslim cultures.
 
 
 
• **Other notable Kathak dancers**
 
 
• Brijmohan Mishra (Birju Maharaj)
 
• Shovana Narayan
 
• Kumudini Lakhia
 
• Maya Rao
 
 
 
• **Importance of Awards in Arts**
 
 
• Awards like the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award provide recognition and encouragement to artists.
 
• They help in preserving and promoting traditional art forms.
 
• Awards contribute to the cultural richness and heritage of a nation.
 
• They also inspire the younger generation to pursue and excel in various art forms.
